== English Reflections III comparison ==
Decipher’s 26 October broadcast names this exact weapon in Essen prerelease play, 20–21 October 2001. The dated replacement limits the protection against stealing to the weapon while on Maul. The original states the protection without that condition. The weapon’s deployment, Force drain, targeting, destiny, hit and forfeit wording remain. “Weld” on the original and “wield” on the replacement are a separate lore correction.
